caption: The drawing depicts a single stone or marble statue of a standing female figure. The statue is rendered in shades of gray, suggesting the texture and appearance of weathered stone. The figure is adorned with a crown or wreath made of flowers on her head, and she has wavy hair that is arranged in a classical style. She wears a long, draped garment that falls in soft, vertical folds to her feet, covering her body except for her hands, neck, and part of her forearms. Her right arm is bent at the elbow, with her hand holding a cluster of flowers or fruit at her chest, while her left arm hangs loosely by her side. The statue stands on a simple, rectangular pedestal with sharp edges, and the background is plain and unadorned, consisting of a beige or off-white color that does not distract from the statue itself. There are visible cracks, chips, and discoloration on the statue, indicating age and wear.
title: Garden Figure
